notes.title: New Release OUT NOW - Wisdom Watcher
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44475093/1d934928ad5a783ac768a761265378bc3f0d379d.png[/img]

Get on board Watchers!🔥  
Today is the day, the [b]NEW RELEASE[/b] of Wisdom Watcher is [b]OUT NOW[/b]!  
Join the battle with us, are you ready to break the current wave record?  ⚔️ 


👉 [b]THIS NEW PATCH IS A TOTAL GAME UPGRADE. HERE ARE THE NOVELTIES[/b]: 

[list]
[*] Introduced an introductory mode that allows you to discover the game progressively.
[*] Added a robotic assistant, L.O.O.P.., who will guide you through the watcher's story and the discovery of the game.
[*] General graphic revamp, with a brand new interactive Hub.
[*] Increased the Waves, the normal mode now has 20 waves, while the hard mode has a staggering 80.
[*] Introduced shields and rebalanced melee combat.
[*] Trap construction has been simplified.
[*] Modified interaction with tip signs.
[*] Added various weak points at specific points on enemies.
[*] Mana and health crystals introduced instead of insects and potions.
[*] General combat balancing.
[*] Renewed enemy AI.
[*] Keep following us, the game is constantly growing! Go, Watchers, unleash hell!
[/list]

Wisdom Watcher continues to evolve with ongoing development, and to ensure the title perseveres to accommodate all users, community feedback is crucial and always appreciated. To reach out to the Space Whale development team directly, you can access the Discord server to become a game tester, or to express opinions.


🎮 Get ready for an unprecedented VR experience, where every victory will bring you closer to salvation... or eternal imprisonment.

notes.notes:

[h3]Following the recent updates shared in our last Devlog, where we outlined our ongoing efforts, we're delighted to present the[b] roadmap[/b] detailing the activities our development team will prioritize in the months ahead. [/h3]

➡️ https://discord.gg/9UqWuWzC62

notes.title: Wisdom Watcher - our new DEVLOG!
notes.notes:
[img]https://8932021.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/8932021/devlog.png[/img]

[h3][b]Hello Watchers! 🧝🧝‍♀️[/b]
In today's development log, we're thrilled to unveil what our team has diligently crafted behind the curtains over the past few months 💥.[/h3] 

Before delving into the specifics, let's recap the key insights we've gathered from your invaluable feedback on our game:


👉🏼 [b]Streamlining the Experience[/b]: Many of you mentioned feeling overwhelmed by the abundance of game mechanics.
👉🏼 [b]Adding a Splash of Color[/b]: Wisdom Watcher needed a touch of "neatness," especially in terms of visual and audio cues.
👉🏼 [b]Demon-Slaying Delight[/b]: Fighting demons in our game brought you immense joy, and that's incredibly heartening to hear!


[b]A huge thank you to those who believed in us and dedicated their time to testing Wisdom Watcher, providing us with invaluable feedback[/b]. Thanks to your efforts, we continue to learn and grow on this journey! If you're interested in joining our beta testing team and contributing your suggestions to enhance the game, please don't hesitate to apply here: https://discord.gg/VvbUEumVbv.




[h3]🧑‍💻 But now, let's get back to our updates!
As we were saying, thanks to your feedback, we're excited to unveil the upcoming significant (and super thrilling) developments, set to be released NEXT MONTH (April is coming!):[/h3]

➡️First and foremost, we've completely revamped the game's start, [b]introducing the STORY MODE[/b], which will help you delve deeper into the bloody history of the Wisdom Watchers and provide a smoother game initiation. The various mechanics will be introduced with a [b]learn-as-you-go approach[/b], allowing players to grasp everything at their own pace. Here's a summary of the new features you'll find at the beginning of the game:

🏰 [b]Watcher's Castle[/b]
Your adventure to discover the Watchers and their millennia-old history will kick off from the halls of the castle.
🧝🏼‍♂️[b]Completely Revamped Hub[/b]
Embracing the clockpunk theme, the new hub will be populated with contraptions such as clocks and interconnected tables, operated by levers and handles.
✨[b]More Immersive Environment[/b]
We've enriched the environment with hints about the story and hidden treasures for those who want to venture into the untold tales of the Wisdom Watchers.
🤖[b]P.A.O.L.O., the one who will tie all the new additions together, will be your guide through the castle halls[/b], offering tasks and tips to survive encounters with demons. P.A.O.L.O. has been brought to life through motion capture and will be a reliable companion in your battles against the forces of darkness.


[img]https://8932021.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/8932021/Immagine_2024-03-13_171658.jpg[/img]

➡️ Next, we dedicated substantial efforts to [b]ENHANCING the game's SOUND DESIGN[/b] to elevate immersion and overall quality:

🔈[b]Sound effects underwent meticulous refinement[/b] to heighten spatial awareness and provide more nuanced action feedback.
🎶[b]An exceptional original soundtrack[/b] has been seamlessly integrated to elevate the intensity of your epic battles against malevolence.
🎤 We've introduced [b]captivating voice acting [/b]to deliver a cinematic-like narrative experience.

➡️ Additionally, we've further [b]POLISHED the VISUAL EFFECTS[/b] based on your feedback, enhancing clarity and readability.

➡️ Regarding [b]GAMEPLAY[/b], once again, we've diligently worked to optimize the experience:

🔥Adjustments have been made to the balance, making [b]melee combat more accessible[/b], enabling players to employ their preferred fighting style in any scenario.
🔥[b]Enemies now possess distinct weaknesses and varying levels of weapon resistance[/b], adding depth to encounters and requiring strategic decision-making. Beware of Krampus—they're formidable adversaries! Pro tip: swords prove particularly effective against them.
🔥The much-anticipated addition has finally arrived: [b]the shield[/b]! Through a specific gesture, players can deploy a formidable shield for protection, granting an advantage in melee combat against demon hordes and offering vital breathing room for strategic repositioning.
🔥Mana bugs have been peacefully returned to their underground dwellings, and health potions have been shelved. Instead, [b]unique glowing crystals[/b] have been introduced to restore health.
🔥The difficulty of the [b]hard mode[/b] has been ramped up for the bravest players, yet we've ensured a balanced progression to provide a fair challenge.


[img]https://8932021.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/8932021/uhduahui.png[/img]

[h3]All of these efforts are aimed at crafting an experience that aligns more closely with your preferences, and we sincerely (truly!) appreciate those who have chosen to embark on this journey with Wisdom Watcher.

But wait, there's more! Soon, we'll unveil a comprehensive roadmap outlining upcoming updates in the next few months. [/h3]

To stay in the loop with all developments, remember to join our Discord channel at https://discord.gg/9UqWuWzC62.


[h3]Now, Watchers, the battle awaits you![/h3]

notes.title: Wisdom Watcher: Early Access Launches Today!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that Wisdom Watcher is launching on Steam today in Early Access! Become a part of the order of Wisdom Watchers and contribute to the game's future development by sharing your valuable feedback [url=https://discord.gg/bCVKz57hMe]on our Discord server.[/url].

The Early Access release includes the following updates:

New Arena
• A full new arena available, called Gate of Hell, thatfeatures multiple platforms, connected by a boardwalk suspended above lava. 

New Gameplay Mode: Nightmare Guardian
• Introducing a new gameplay mode where players must stay within the boundaries of a circle and prevent monsters from lingering there. Players can use weapons and the new build feature from the newly introduced card system.

New Card System
• Players can equip cards before entering combat, using them in various ways: cards alter weapon effects or allow building helpful items in the arena, like barricades.

New Mob
• Introduction of a new mob, the first mini-boss called Bauk.

HUB and UI Revamp
• Complete overhaul of the in-game UI for clearer and more accessible information.
• Redesigned player HUB for easier access to arenas, tutorials, leaderboards, and achievements.

New Tutorial System
• The tutorial will be segmented, with each part accessible independently.

New Progression System with Achievements
• Points earned in arenas can be used to unlock items, arenas, gameplay modes, etc.
• Arena rewards will be given at the end of each arena through a reward chest.

Combat Update
• Weapons can be equipped before entering combat.
• Introduction of mobs at different levels, distinguishable by graphic elements. Higher-level mobs will be stronger and increase gameplay difficulty.
• Each mob will have specific weak points, making them more vulnerable.

Melee Weapons Revamp
• Complete revamp of melee weapons: initially, two different melee weapons will be available, each with unique features.

And of course several bugs fixed

notes.title: New demo patch!
notes.notes:
[u][b]Major Updates:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] new intro arena Colosseum for quick tutorial
[*] removed guns reload and added continuous bullet flow using mana
[*]movement system upgraded
[*] added ranged core absorption feature
[*] added ranged multi core absorption feature
[*] removed stagger of enemies
[*] fix of the swing and damage of melee weapons
[/list]

[u][b]Minor updates:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] automatic chest opening once the player run near by
[*] settings menu on central overlay
[*] Kalafak explosion time reduced
[*] fix firearm recoil
[*] added version number of the game in the settings menu
[/list]

Now available a [b]new introduction arena[/b] with a big spoiler of something coming…you should play to find out, we want to keep it secret! You will now be introduced to the gameplay with various tips and tricks before joining the hub.
The [b]old tutorial with more in depth instruction will remain available[/b] anytime through the main room of the hub, so don’t worry if you’ll miss some instructions while playing the intro. 

We also [b]updated the overall gameplay[/b], introducing new functions like the opportunity to [b]absorb the core [/b]like the players did with the mana potions, and you will be able to [b]absorb many of them  using the same long grab input[/b].

Even the [b]melee weapons are now improved[/b], if you execute a good swing you’ll be able to gain the same points like shooting with a gun.

[b]Running it’s way easier[/b] than before, and you can grab and throw the [b]Kalafak with an explosion time reduced[/b], so be quick and don’t waste time!

And talking about time… you can now see all the [b]chests opening automatically while you pass near them[/b], in this way you’ll be able to grab the weapon without being an easy target for monster.!
We know our monsters are kinda…aggressive maybe? But don’t worry, this time we [b]removed the guns reload system[/b], so now you’ll be free to shoot with continuous flow through your mana. But don’t forget to recharge it! You are still human eheh.

And just a small tip before starting your new adventure: we[b] added the version number of the game in the settings menu[/b]! In this way you can keep us updated through your feedback while fast checking on the version you are currently playing!

As always, we are looking for your opinions and feedback! [url=https://discord.com/invite/S2fqJYGGDg]Join our Discord server [/url]and let us know what you think!
Start your engine and may the best Wisdom Watcher win!
